summary: Private 60-second Settings Search unlock for the WhatsApp code vault; retain corrected Emoji key motion.

changes.title: Shared Search and Backspace motion
changes.detail: Search travels from bottom right to the Emoji Search position; Backspace moves into the bottom-right slot. Reverse on return. Existing key sizes, colors and layout retained.

changes.title: Remove incorrect key-to-field morph
changes.detail: Search fields appear normally in Emoji and Clipboard. No X morph, no additional Clipboard entry animation or whole-panel fade.

changes.title: Hidden vault unlock
changes.detail: Holding brrBoard Settings vibrates and arms the existing search bar for 60 seconds without navigating. Enter the enrolled WhatsApp secret code to open vault settings automatically.

changes.title: Private code entry and recovery
changes.detail: Masked private input bypasses ordinary settings filtering and learning; no default password, clears on timeout or background. Local Keystore verifier and separately authenticated setup/recovery retain device-credential protection.
